purpose: tooling/repository_hygiene.py's validate_no_embedded_absolute_local_paths (GOVERNING_PRINCIPLES.md principle 14's standing check) treats every entry here as excluded from THIS check's current enforcement, but -- unlike ABSOLUTE_LOCAL_PATH_CITATIONS.json -- an entry here is NOT a claim that the excluded content is compliant; it records a real or plausible finding this check's construction deliberately declined to adjudicate, and why, so a future reviewer does not have to re-run the sweep to know what is pending. This registry starts empty: the sweep that built this check found zero absolute-local-path embeddings in this repository's active, tracked content, so nothing needed deferring. It must never grow silently as a way to dodge a new violation -- every entry needs the same kind of explicit human review this check's own construction required.
